notes: The date and place before the chain («في منـزله ببغداد ...») are not names; «أبيه» is named only by relation to «سفيان بن إبراهيم الجريري» so it is a relation; «أمير المؤمنين» is written as a title, not a personal name, and is the speaker of the saying («أنه قال»), so it is kept as the last link; needs_ruling because a title alone is not otherwise settled by the rules (rule 1, rule 6)
